name: Shimron
title: Son of Issachar
summary: Shimron was the fourth son of Issachar, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He was among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family. Shimron became the ancestor of the Shimronite clan among the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Shimron as Son of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Shimron was born as the fourth son of Issachar, Jacob's son with Leah. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Jacob's descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Shimron was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt during the famine, when Joseph was the viceroy of the land.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Issachar's Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shimron is listed among the sons of Issachar in the genealogies recorded during Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: The Shimronite clan in the census
keyEvents.description: During the census in the wilderness, Shimron's descendants were registered as the Shimronite clan, a part of the tribe of Issachar.

keyEvents.title: Sons of Issachar mentioned in Exodus
keyEvents.description: Shimron is listed among the sons of Issachar when Jacob's family came to Egypt, as part of the broader narrative of the people of Israel.
